player_prompt.intro:
Wo reko Minesweeper agoro no.
Agoro no botae ne sɛ wo bɛ kyerɛ cells nyinaa a na mino nni mu.
Sɛ wo pɛ sɛ wo yɛ kwan, kyerɛ row ne column nkyekyɛmu a wo pɛ sɛ wo kyerɛ no ase, fa mfoni:
- `[row col]`: Kye cell a ɛwɔ row ne column a wo kyerɛe no.
Sɛ nhwɛso:
- `[3 2]` kye cell a ɛwɔ Row 3, Column 2.
- `[5 6]` kye cell a ɛwɔ Row 5, Column 6.
Wo kwan a edi kan no, wo bɛ kyerɛ asaase a atwa cell a wo ayɛ no ho ahyia sɛnea ɛbɛ yɛ daakye awo.
Mprempren board layout a ɛwɔ ha yi:

invalid_move.wrong_format: W'asɛm no nkyerɛ baabi a ɛwɔ.
invalid_move.out_of_bounds: Nkyekyɛmu a wɔaka ho asɛm no nni nsɛdi mu.

outcome.win: Mo ani agye sɛ moatumi adi Minesweeper no ho dwuma yiye.
outcome.turn_limit: Woadi nea wobɛtumi de ahwehwɛ no so nkonim. Wode {percent}% a ɛwɔ nkwammoaa mu no adi dwuma yiye.
